title: Rhombus-Shaped Tetranuclear [Ln4] Complexes [Ln = Dy(III) and Ho(III)]: Synthesis, Structure, and SMM Behavior

synthesis.procedure: LH3 (0.05 g, 0.155 mmol) was dissolved in methanol (10 mL) and dichloromethane (15 mL) to give a colorless solution. Two equivalents of DyCl3·6H2O (0.117 g, 0.31 mmol) were added, immediately producing a deep-red solution. After stirring at room temperature for 10 min, three equivalents of triethylamine (0.047 g, 0.465 mmol) were added dropwise. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 20 h, filtered, and left to crystallize. After about 15 days, slow evaporation of the methanol/dichloromethane mother liquor afforded block-shaped deep-red crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray crystallography.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution synthesis followed by slow evaporation of the mother liquor
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered after stirring; block-shaped deep-red crystals grown by slow evaporation of the MeOH/CH2Cl2 mother liquor over about 15 days

properties.summary: Static susceptibility of 1 shows χMT = 53.4 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K, a plateau near 44.5 cm3 mol−1 K between 20 and 10 K, and 29.6 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K reaches 19.2 μB at 50 kOe without saturation. AC susceptibility below 20 K is frequency-dependent with two χM″ maxima (3.9 and 10.7 K at 1490 Hz), corresponding to two SMM relaxation processes attributed to the two distinct Dy(III) sites (Ueff/kB = 16.8 and 54.2 K).

properties.summary: χMT of 2 is 53.0 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K, decreasing continuously and more rapidly below 30 K to 21.0 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K.
